data.body: Patchset 2 on Gerrit change 2008 after Verified -1 on PS1. Root causes of the CI failures (both mine): (1) _jscpd._default_run(*args) tripped the raw-git-write gate's fail-closed unresolvable-argv rule — fixed by mirroring the sanctioned sibling pattern scc_loc._run_scc (named runner taking command: list[str] with the raw-git-ok marker 'generic command runner, argv supplied by caller'). (2) The two _ref_lock seam tests asserted exact equality on a GLOBAL time.sleep capture; on slow CI hosts stdlib subprocess's timeout-poll backoff (doubling, capped 0.05s) also calls time.sleep, polluting the capture (observed series 0.001..0.032). Fixed by asserting membership of a distinctive 7.5s lease value instead of list equality. All gates re-green locally: 96 targeted tests, lint 0, mypy clean, ratchet new=0 increased=0.
